sentences.en: We've been matched up with some strong teams this year.
sentences.zh: 今年我们被分到了一些实力很强的队伍。

sentences.en: It was apparent to everybody that our team was stronger.
sentences.zh: 大家都很清楚我们的队伍更强。

sentences.en: The first baseman is the Achilles heel of our team.
sentences.zh: 一垒手是我们队伍的一个弱点。

senses.zh: 协同工作；合作；把（牛马等）联套在车上
